name: Link Skins
author: Jack
description: Pick a skin for Link. Skins are folders in mods\link-skins\skins.

settings.name: Link's skin
settings.help: No restart: save and quit to the title screen, then load your save (or change age). Tunics change when put on again.

settings.name: Size table
settings.help: Co-op hides the other players while a mod brings its own size table. 'None' is a test: skins without one.
